title: feat: add Pollinations MCP to Open WebUI on the user's own key
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Registers `https://mcp.pollinations.ai/` as an MCP tool server with `auth_type: system_oauth`, so tool calls reuse the same per-user consent key as chat — generation from a tool call is billed to the signed-in user's own wallet, not a shared admin key.
- Grants public read. An empty `access_grants` list means admin-only, not everyone.
- Documents that `DEFAULT_CONFIG` vars seed the Postgres `config` table only when the key is absent, so editing them on a live DB is a silent no-op.

Verified end-to-end on staging: the tool lists for a non-admin user, and a real chat executed `getBalance`, returning the user's own key-scoped balance (15.59 of a 20-pollen consent budget) rather than the account-wide balance — proving per-user forwarding. The live config row is already applied to staging and production; this commit keeps the declared config in sync for a fresh database.

gist.headline: Your wallet, your tools
gist.blurb: Pollinations MCP now lives in Open WebUI with per-user OAuth. Ask a chat to use a tool, and the pollen comes from your own consented wallet—not the communal jar.
gist.summary: Added the Pollinations MCP server at https://mcp.pollinations.ai/ to Open WebUI with system OAuth, forwarding each signed-in user's consent key to tool calls and exposing it publicly to non-admin users.
gist.impact: Open WebUI users can now run Pollinations MCP tools such as getBalance from chat with their own key-scoped Pollen budget and billing, rather than an account-wide admin balance.
